---
params:
  exercices: !r list()
  titre: "Fiche d'exercices"
  sous_titre: ""
  instructions: ""
  corriges: false
  afficher_metadonnees: false
  logo: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
exercices = params$exercices
```

```{r logo, out.width="12%", fig.align="left"}
if (nzchar(params$logo) && file.exists(params$logo)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(params$logo)
}
```

# `r params$titre`

```{r introduction, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(params$sous_titre)) cat("*", params$sous_titre, "*\n\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(params$instructions) && nzchar(params$instructions)) {
  cat("**Consigne générale :** ", params$instructions, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r exercices, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_along(exercices)) {
  ex = exercices[[i]]
  cat("## Exercice ", i, "\n\n", sep = "")

  if (isTRUE(params$corriges)) {
    cat(ex$correction, "\n\n")
    if (!is.null(ex$reponse) && nzchar(as.character(ex$reponse))) {
      cat("**Réponse :** ", as.character(ex$reponse), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat(ex$enonce, "\n\n")
  }

  if (isTRUE(params$afficher_metadonnees)) {
    meta = c(
      if (!is.null(ex$modele_id)) paste0("modèle: ", ex$modele_id),
      if (!is.null(ex$capacite_id) && !is.na(ex$capacite_id) && nzchar(ex$capacite_id)) paste0("capacité: ", ex$capacite_id),
      if (!is.null(ex$difficulte)) paste0("difficulté: ", ex$difficulte),
      if (!is.null(ex$seed) && !is.na(ex$seed)) paste0("seed: ", ex$seed)
    )
    if (length(meta)) cat("*", paste(meta, collapse = " — "), "*\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
